players.name: Gemini Decision 1 [repeat 1]
players.note: Google's Gemini Decision 1 (gemini-decision-1, launched 11 Nov 2026) through OpenRouter's System One route (/api/v1/systemone, model google/gemini-decision-1; replies name google/gemini-decision-1-20261111), pinned to its one provider, Google AI Studio, with fallbacks off (provider.only [google-ai-studio], allow_fallbacks false). List price $0.10 per million input tokens, no output tokens (openrouter.ai/google/gemini-decision-1 and aistudio.google.com/docs/pricing, 11 Nov 2026); latency includes OpenRouter's own time. One choice question per request with up to 255 options (the API's limit; longer lists split by the league's rule); context 262,144 tokens, refused with 400 above it, never cut: League 1's largest stored request (229 options, 57,539 bytes) was 26,133 input tokens at the smoke test. The API sorts option keys alphabetically (UTF-8 bytes) before evaluation, so the model reads the options in that order, not the seeded one (aistudio.google.com/docs/decisions-api#choice). OpenRouter answers some 429s (Google's per-tier token limit): retried as on every route. Reproducibility repeat 1 (gemini-decision-1-r1; tools/v3/repeats, mailbox/repeats/manifest-2026-11-11.json): the original's League 1 field again, one match at a time, each pair with its original match's seed and seats; held: in no standings, table, Cup input or other setup's numbers.
